# Hirefit

> Free AI resume tailoring tool: upload your resume, paste a job description, and get an ATS-optimized resume with a matching cover letter.

Hirefit is a web app that tailors resumes to any job description using six AI tools: JD analyzer, resume analyzer, gap analyzer, ATS scorer, resume rewriter, and cover letter generator. It is preservation-first — it keeps every technology, skill, and metric from your original resume and never invents experience.

## Key pages

- [JD Analyzer](https://tailor-resume-agent.vercel.app/tools/jd-analyzer)
- [Gap Analyzer](https://tailor-resume-agent.vercel.app/tools/gap-analyzer)
- [Resume Rewriter](https://tailor-resume-agent.vercel.app/tools/resume-rewriter)
- [Cover Letter Generator](https://tailor-resume-agent.vercel.app/tools/cover-letter-generator)
